name: B10-0424/2026 – After § 1 – Am 89
title: MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for an EU strategy to counter Islamist entryism and the influence of the Muslim Brotherhood network
part_text: 1a. Condemns the incidents of hate crime and hate speech motivated by racism, antisemitism, xenophobia or religious intolerance, or minority status; calls on the Commission and the Member States to intensify work on exchanging best practices and to strengthen their cooperation in combating racism, antisemitism, xenophobia, antimuslim hatred and other forms of intolerance, with the full inclusion of civil society and with contribution of relevant stakeholders such as the Fundamental Rights Agency;
